info.name: InvoiceFlow API
info.description: Minimal Postman collection for the current InvoiceFlow API surface. It covers health checks, invoice document processing with X-API-Key, missing API key behavior, invalid content type behavior, and local rate limit verification when API key identity and client rate limiting are configured.

request.description: Public health endpoint. This endpoint does not require X-API-Key.

formdata.description: Select a local PDF, JPG, or PNG invoice document. The default collection variable points to /tmp/invoice.pdf. For local smoke testing, create it with: printf '%s\n' '%PDF-1.7 fake invoice content' > /tmp/invoice.pdf

request.description: Processes an invoice or receipt document using multipart/form-data and a valid X-API-Key header.

formdata.description: Select a local PDF, JPG, or PNG invoice document. The default collection variable points to /tmp/invoice.pdf. For local smoke testing, create it with: printf '%s\n' '%PDF-1.7 fake invoice content' > /tmp/invoice.pdf

request.description: Verifies that a protected invoice processing request without X-API-Key returns 401 INVALID_API_KEY when API key identity is configured.
Verifies upload boundary behavior for a non-multipart request. Expected response: 400 INVALID_CONTENT_TYPE.

formdata.description: Use the same invoice file as the valid API key flow. To verify rate limiting locally, run the API with API key identity configured and ClientRateLimiting configured with a low limit, for example PermitLimit=1 and Window=00:10:00. Send one valid request first, then send this request. Expected response: 429 RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

request.description: Verifies local per-client rate limit behavior. This request is expected to return 429 with RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED after the same API key has already consumed the configured request limit for POST /api/invoices/process. This scenario requires API key identity and InvoiceFlow:ClientRateLimiting to be configured.
